denver-colorado-rockies-peak-to-peak-hig.story: Scenery first, traffic last, with checkpoints that make sense on a bike. A 336 km loop that starts and ends near Brighton, about 7 h of riding. The stops in between: Lyons, near Central City, near Roxborough Park and Littleton. The climbs: Near Lyons, on the way back and near Parker. It tops out at about 3,200 m. Long stretches are under trees.

sections.advice: Treat Food stop near Central City → Photo stop near Roxborough Park as bend craft. Brake early, look high through the turn, and keep throttle changes gentle. It is more satisfying to link ten clean bends than rescue one silly one.
Photo stop near Roxborough Park → Littleton is shade riding: beautiful, cooler and sometimes slick. Expect damp patches, leaves, gravel and wildlife where the trees meet the road.

Use High point near Parker → Scenic stretch near Aurora as clean positioning. Keep it tidy, ignore impatient traffic and save the enthusiasm for the good road ahead. The value here is not drama; it is arriving at the riding section with space, fuel and concentration intact.
